name: Nul the Sightline
prompt: Nul the Sightline — a LARGE sentinel BOSS, limbless pill-blob construction, side-on facing RIGHT on flat green (#00b140). A bulbous dark-violet body DOMINATED by one huge lidless eye (pale-cyan iris, black slit pupil, off-white sclera), on a short thick stalk-neck at the base. Detached small blob hands float clear OUTSIDE the silhouette low at the sides, defensive, with a flat-green gap around each. Tiny detached blob feet below. Head-heavy and imposing, ~2.7x a normal enemy. ~5 colours (dark violet, pale cyan eye, off-white sclera, muted magenta shadow, black outline); bold uniform black outline, flat cel shading, two-tone. NO baked beam, NO glow, NO VFX — the eye is calm and closed-lipped.
